goal: Upgrade existing Play/Play From Here/dev-client bridge into Unreal-style editor testing without breaking current standalone launch.
preserve: current Play and Play From Here commands

playModes.description: run world simulation in editor without taking player control
frame the live runtime session inside Game Canvas for editor testing
start from selected/cursor world or scene cell
future local host plus N clients for co-op validation

acceptance: Game Canvas shows play state, world id, scene id, spawn, runtime status, and registry versions.
Input capture is explicit and Stop returns to Edit mode.
Editor and runtime consume the same saved world/metadata/assets/topology versions.
New embedded/framed mode does not remove the external client fallback.
